figurative_meaning_bn: বারবার ব্যর্থতায় হতাশ হয়ে মাথা কোটা
figurative_meaning_en: To repeatedly fail or struggle in frustration, akin to banging one's head
similar_in_english: Bang one's head against a wall
Beat one's head against a brick wall
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একই প্রকল্পে মাথা ঠোকছে বছরের পর বছর।
এই সমস্যায় মাথা ঠোকার কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He's been banging his head against the same project for years.
There's no point in banging your head against this problem.
note: This idiom vividly captures Bengali expressions of exasperation in futile efforts.
